name: config-string-previews
goal: Show decoded configuration strings inline, ellipsizing long and multiline text while retaining source-safe inspection for collections and computed expressions.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Decoded string literals must show their beginning inline and ellipsize within the value cell. Collections and computed expressions retain source-safe inspection. Source review identifies ConfigValue gating strings on valueMark; browser reproduction awaits the released validation window.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: PR79 typed-value coverage excluded archivePath from decoded literal metadata, so the standard groups matrix tested its source-inspection path instead of a long string. Strengthen entityConfigFixtures, entityPreviewConfigs, the catalog screen test and the static parser matrix; preserve existing computed-expression and collection assertions. Local Harness fixture-review guidance now requires type and source-provenance partitions.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Accepted record d24f7b22a7c59de85169a4fc4e19e4674ce686bf6fb2dce481150226877acbf9 at 5476d3784 proves missing inline decoded strings and unwanted inspection buttons across all three declared viewports, at current and historical synthetic revisions. Retained 132 attributed captures and 264 contextual measurements; original current screenshots reopened and hash-checked. Earlier two setup attempts were rejected and remain diagnostics only.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: ConfigValue now selects decoded string text independently of source-length inspection and constrains it to one ellipsized line. Arrays, objects and unevaluated expressions retain existing inspection. Other scalar presentations and full accessible string values are preserved; the regression tests remain unchanged.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Passing record 3362b14bbabf935eac102268cc24bd303d2445b5dd1aba8e5932362564eb70c2 at b09e4d0ce91eb5dba0712092b7b91353c7386ca0 preserves the unchanged command, inputs, assertions and normal resource profile of accepted red d24f7b22a7c59de85169a4fc4e19e4674ce686bf6fb2dce481150226877acbf9 at 5476d3784. All three declared viewports pass in current and historical synthetic modes; 132 passing captures and 264 contextual measurements are retained. All 264 original red/green bindings were reopened from evidence Git, hash-checked and decoded as 71 unique original images; twelve representative originals were visually inspected. Owning Reports check and 32 static parser tests pass in capture f1917912021562041d86a216a0e1db8f94dcefb0681db695e7b68de703fcb675. Main integration, shared preview verification and intentionally deferred full CLI/native checks remain pending.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
